name: Bijoy Hans Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Bijoy Hans Ltd is in the business of Pharmaceutical, Medical and Cosmetics goods[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company does Wholesale of Pharmaceutical and Medical Goods and Cosmetics. It offers various pharmaceutical formulations such as tablets, capsules, syrups, suspension and powders, focusing on segments viz. Antibiotics, Cough/cold/allergy, H-1 receptor Antagonist (Antiulcerant), Nutraceutical, and NSAIDS

cons: Stock is trading at 4.17 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -0.37%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -10.6% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -10.5% over last 3 years.
